DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 奥の土の道は雨でぬかるんでいます。散歩でしたら、案内図をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: The dirt path farther in is muddy from the rain. If you are taking a walk, would you like to see the map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: これから人に会うので、靴を汚したくありません。舗装された道だけで十五分くらい歩けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 人と会う前なので靴を汚さず舗装路で十五分歩きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am meeting someone afterward, so I do not want to get my shoes dirty. Can I walk for about fifteen minutes using only paved paths?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that before meeting someone, you want a fifteen-minute walk on paved paths without dirtying your shoes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この入口から右へ進む短いコースなら舗装路です。途中に一か所、大きな水たまりがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The short route going right from this entrance is paved. There is one large puddle along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 水たまりをよけるには、草の上に入る必要がありますか。できれば舗装路から外れたくないです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 草に入らず舗装路のままよけられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Do I have to step onto the grass to avoid the puddle? I would prefer not to leave the paved path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can avoid it while staying on the pavement instead of stepping on grass. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: いいえ、ベンチ側の道幅が広いので、舗装路のままよけられます。向かいから人が来たら、通り過ぎるのを待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: No, the path is wide on the bench side, so you can avoid it on the pavement. If someone approaches, wait for them to pass.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: わかりました。同行する母が疲れたとき、そのベンチで休めますか。座面はぬれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 母が疲れた際にベンチを使え座面がぬれていないか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. Can my mother rest on that bench if she gets tired? Is the seat wet?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether your mother can use the bench when tired and whether its seat is wet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 先ほど確認したときは端がぬれていました。乾いている所を見て座ってください。戻るなら、無理に一周する必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: When I checked earlier, the end was wet. Look for a dry part before sitting. If you want to return, you do not have to complete a full circuit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 母が休みたいと言ったら引き返します。この入口を見失わない目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 母が休みたければ引き返すとして入口を示す目印を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If my mother says she wants to rest, we will turn back. Is there a landmark to help us recognize this entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will turn back if your mother wants to rest, and ask for a landmark marking the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入口の横に青い案内板があります。戻るときは『出口』の矢印と、その案内板を目印にしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: There is a blue information board beside the entrance. On your return, use the arrow marked 'Exit' and that board as landmarks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 青い案内板を覚えておきます。舗装路を右へ進んで、水たまりでは母と立ち止まって人を先に通します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 青い案内板を覚え右の舗装路を進み水たまりで歩行者を先に通すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will remember the blue board. We will follow the paved path to the right, and my mother and I will stop by the puddle to let people pass first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will remember the blue board, take the paved path to the right, and let pedestrians pass first at the puddle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ゆっくりお楽しみください。ぬれた所は滑りやすいので、お二人とも足元にお気をつけて。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take your time and enjoy your walk. Wet places can be slippery, so both of you please watch your step. Have a lovely walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切符をお買い求めですね。何名様で、どちらまでお出かけですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like tickets. How many people, and where are you going?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人と二人で隣の駅まで行きます。行きは一緒ですが、帰る時刻は別々です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人で隣駅へ行き行きは一緒だが帰る時刻は異なると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend and I are going to the next station. We will go together, but return at different times.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that two people are going to the next station together but returning at different times. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: では、一人ずつ使えるように切符を分けましょう。今日の行きの分だけ購入されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Then let us issue separate tickets for each person to use. Are you buying just the outward journey today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、帰りはそれぞれで買います。二人分を一枚にまとめないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 行きだけ二人分を買い一枚にまとめないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, we will each buy our return ticket. Please do not combine the two people into one ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Buy the outward journey for two and ask not to combine it into one ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。この窓口で、同じ区間の片道切符を二枚お出しできます。お支払いはご一緒でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Certainly. This counter can issue two one-way tickets for the same section. Will you pay together?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私がまとめて払います。友人は切符に慣れていないので、買った二枚のどちらを渡しても大丈夫か知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: まとめて支払うと伝え同一区間の二枚はどちらを友人に渡してもよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will pay for both. My friend is not used to tickets, so I want to know whether either of the two tickets can be given to them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will pay together and ask whether either ticket for the same section can be given to your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同じ区間の切符ですので、どちらでも使えます。改札では一人一枚ずつ入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Both cover the same section, so either can be used. Insert one ticket per person at the gate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 途中で切符が戻ってきたら、それぞれ取って持っていればいいんですね。友人が先に進んでも私は自分の切符で通れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 戻る切符は各自で取り友人が先に通っても自分の切符で通れるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: If the tickets come back out along the way, we should each take and keep our own, right? If my friend goes ahead, can I pass with my own ticket?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether each should collect a returned ticket and you can pass with your own if your friend goes ahead. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、それぞれの切符で通ります。改札の先で待ち合わせて、二人とも通れたことを確認してから乗り場へ進むと安心です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, each uses their own ticket. It is reassuring to meet beyond the gates and confirm both have passed before proceeding to the boarding area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: それなら改札の先で合流します。片道二枚を一緒に払って、一枚ずつ持って入ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 片道二枚を購入し一人一枚を持って改札の先で合流すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then we will meet beyond the gates. I will pay for two one-way tickets together, and we will each hold one when entering.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will buy two one-way tickets, carry one each, and meet beyond the gates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが二枚の切符です。お忘れ物のないよう、ご友人と確かめてください。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are the two tickets. Please check with your friend that nothing has been left behind. Have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの封筒は市民講習の案内ですね。どの点を確認されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: The envelope you have contains information about a public course. What would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 防災講習に申し込んだのですが、この通知では日付が変わっています。新しい日は仕事で参加できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 防災講習の日付が変わり変更後の日は仕事で参加できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I applied for a disaster-prevention course, but this notice changes the date. I cannot attend on the new day because I have work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the disaster-prevention course date changed and you cannot attend the new date because of work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会場の都合で日程が変わった講習ですね。下の返信欄で、変更後の日に参加するかどうかお知らせいただく案内です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: That course was rescheduled because of the venue. The notice asks you to reply in the section below whether you will attend on the new date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 参加できない場合も返信が必要なんですね。『欠席』に丸を付けるだけでよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 参加できない場合も返信し欠席欄に丸を付ければよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I need to reply even if I cannot attend. Is it enough to circle 'Absent'?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you must reply even if unable to attend and can circle the absence field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、お名前もご記入ください。今回の欠席を伝える欄なので、今後の講習まで辞退するという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, please write your name too. This field is for reporting this absence, not withdrawing from all future courses.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 次の講習には参加したいです。次回の案内を希望することも、余白に書いていいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 次の講習に参加したいので余白に案内希望を書いてよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to attend the next course. May I also write in the margin that I want information about the next one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may request the next course's information in the margin because you want to attend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お書きいただけます。次回の日程はまだ決まっていませんので、案内を希望する旨を担当に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You may. The next date is not set yet, so I will tell the staff that you would like information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 返信期限が金曜と書いてあります。郵便だと間に合うかわからないので、今日この窓口で渡せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 金曜の期限までに郵便が届くか不明なので今日窓口で渡せるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: It says the reply deadline is Friday. I do not know whether post would arrive in time, so can I hand it in at this counter today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can hand it in today because you are unsure post will arrive by Friday's deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、こちらで担当へ渡します。欠席の丸と、お名前、次回案内のご希望をご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, we will pass it to the staff. Please circle absence, write your name, and state that you want information about the next course.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 記入しました。今回は欠席で、次回の案内は希望しています。この返信用紙をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今回欠席と次回案内希望を記入した用紙を渡すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have filled it in. I will be absent this time and would like the next announcement. I will give you this reply form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you are handing over the form completed with this absence and a request for the next announcement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お預かりしました。ご都合が合う回にぜひご参加ください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have received it. Please join a session that suits your schedule. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めてのご受診ですね。今、どのような症状が出ていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is your first visit. What symptoms are you having now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日から両手首が赤くなって、かゆいです。夜も気になって何度か目が覚めました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日から両手首が赤くかゆく夜も目が覚めたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Both wrists have been red and itchy since yesterday. It bothered me at night and woke me several times.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that both wrists have been red and itchy since yesterday, waking you at night. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 息苦しさや、顔・口の周りの腫れはありませんか。症状が急に広がっているかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have difficulty breathing or swelling around your face or mouth? Please also tell me whether the symptoms are spreading rapidly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 息苦しさも顔の腫れもありません。今のところ手首だけで、昨日より範囲は広がっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 息苦しさや顔の腫れはなく手首のみで範囲が広がっていないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have neither breathing difficulty nor facial swelling. For now it is only my wrists, and the area has not spread since yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that there is no breathing difficulty or facial swelling, only the wrists, with no spreading. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: わかりました。問診票にも経過をご記入ください。受診に必要な書類は、受付で確認します。お持ちの物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. Please also write the course of symptoms on the medical questionnaire. Reception will check the documents needed. Have you brought anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 資格確認書と在留カードを持ってきました。初診なので診察券はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 資格確認書と在留カードがあり診察券はないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I brought my health insurance eligibility confirmation document and residence card. Since this is my first visit, I do not have a patient card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have the eligibility confirmation document and residence card but no patient card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 診察券はなくても、その旨を受付へお伝えください。最近、手首に触れる物や使う物が変わったことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Even without a patient card, tell reception that. Has anything touching your wrists or anything you use changed recently?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 仕事用の手袋が新しい種類になりました。原因かはわかりませんが、袋に商品名があるので持参しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 仕事の手袋の種類が変わり原因は不明だが商品袋を持参したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The work gloves changed to a new type. I do not know whether that caused it, but I brought the packaging because it has the product name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that your work glove type changed; the cause is unknown, but you brought its packaging. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それも診察でお見せください。何が原因かは医師が確認します。受付が済んだら、診察室前の椅子でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Show that during the consultation too. The doctor will check the cause. After reception, wait in the chairs outside the consultation room.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受付で書類を見せて問診票を書きます。手袋の袋も診察のときに出します。待っている間に症状が変わったら声をかけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 書類と問診票を受付に出し袋を診察で見せ待機中の変化は知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show reception the documents and fill out the questionnaire. I will also show the glove packaging during the consultation. If symptoms change while waiting, I will tell someone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will submit the documents and questionnaire at reception, show the packaging at consultation, and report changes while waiting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、変化があればすぐお知らせください。受付へお進みください。失礼いたします。どうぞお大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please tell us immediately if anything changes. Proceed to reception. Excuse me, and take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 手にお持ちの鍵を届けに来られたのでしょうか。こちらの台に置いていただき、お話を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you come to hand in the keys you are holding? Please place them on this counter and tell me what happened.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、さっき歩道で拾いました。小さな札に店の名前があるようですが、どこへ届けるべきかわからなくて来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 歩道で鍵を拾い札に店名らしい表示があるが届け先が不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I found them on the pavement just now. The small tag seems to have a shop name, but I did not know where to take them, so I came here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you found keys on the pavement with what appears to be a shop name on the tag, but do not know where to hand them in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらでお預かりできます。どのあたりで、何時ごろ拾われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can receive them here. Approximately where and when did you find them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅へ向かう道の、横断歩道の手前です。午後三時十分ごろ、側溝のふたの上に落ちていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 駅への道の横断歩道手前で十五時十分に側溝のふた上から拾ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: On the road toward the station, just before the pedestrian crossing. They were on a drainage-channel cover around 3:10 in the afternoon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you found them at15:10 on a drain cover before a crossing on the way to the station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 場所と時刻を記録します。鍵が何の鍵か、持ち主に心当たりはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will record the place and time. Do you know what the keys are for or have an idea who owns them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: わかりません。札の店が持ち主とは限りませんし、鍵を試したり店に入ったりはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持ち主は不明で札の店と断定せず鍵を試すなどしていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not know. The shop on the tag is not necessarily the owner, and I have not tried the keys or gone into the shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the owner is unknown; you have not assumed it is the shop or tried the keys. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのまま届けてくださってありがとうございます。札を含めてこちらで確認します。拾った後、鍵から何か外しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you for bringing them as they are. We will check the tag too. Did you remove anything from the keys after finding them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いいえ、リングも札も付いたままです。汚れを落としたりもしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: リングと札を外さず汚れも落としていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, the ring and tag are still attached. I have not cleaned off any dirt either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that neither ring nor tag was removed and no dirt was cleaned off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。届け出のため、この欄にお名前と連絡先をご記入ください。鍵について確認が必要な場合に連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. For the report, please write your name and contact details in this field. We will contact you if we need to check anything about the keys.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名前と連絡先を書きます。記憶があいまいになる前に、拾った位置もこの地図に印を付けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 氏名連絡先を記入し拾った位置を地図に示したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write my name and contact details. Before my memory becomes vague, I would also like to mark the location on this map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Offer to enter your name and contact details and mark the finding location on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、位置も確認して記録します。鍵は確かにお預かりしました。ご協力ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will check and record the location too. We have received the keys. Thank you for your cooperation. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居届の用紙をお探しでしょうか。お引っ越しのご予定を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a mail-forwarding change-of-address form? Could you tell me about your move?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今、友人と住んでいますが、来月は私だけ引っ越します。友人の郵便まで新居に来ないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人は今の家に残り自分だけ来月引っ越すので友人の郵便を転送したくないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I live with a friend now, but only I will move next month. I do not want my friend's mail to come to the new home too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend will remain and only you move next month, so you do not want their mail forwarded. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この届けでは、転居される方のお名前を記載します。残るご友人のお名前は、転居する方の欄には書かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: This form lists the names of people who are moving. Do not write your friend's name in the mover field if they are staying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、今の住所は二人が住んでいる住所を書いて、転居する人の名前は私だけにすればいいんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧住所は共同の住所で転居する人の名前は自分だけと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I write our shared current address as the old address, but only my name as the person moving, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that the old address is the shared one but only your name is entered as moving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。新しい住所も部屋番号までご記入ください。お二人のお名前が併記された郵便物など、扱いを確認したい物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Enter the new address including the room number too. Is there anything you want to check, such as mail addressed jointly to both of you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 共同で申し込んだ荷物はありません。ただ、私宛ての雑誌が毎月届くので、それをどうすればよいか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 共同の荷物はないが自分宛ての毎月の雑誌への対応を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: We have no parcels ordered jointly. But a magazine comes to me every month, so I want to know what to do with that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that there are no joint parcels, but ask what to do about your monthly magazine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 転居届とは別に、雑誌の送り主へも住所変更をお知らせください。転送を頼んでも、送り主の登録住所が自動で変わるわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Separately from this form, notify the magazine sender of your new address too. Requesting forwarding does not automatically update the sender's registered address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 雑誌の会社には自分で連絡します。引っ越す日ぎりぎりに届けを出すと、すぐ転送が始まるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 雑誌会社には自分で連絡し転居直前の届けで即時開始するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will contact the magazine company myself. If I submit the form just before moving, will forwarding start immediately?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will contact the magazine company and ask whether a last-minute form starts forwarding immediately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: すぐに始まるとは限りません。手続きに時間がかかる場合がありますので、開始希望日を含めて早めに確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: It may not start immediately. Processing can take time, so please check early, including your desired starting date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日用紙を持ち帰って、新居の部屋番号を確認してから出します。友人の名前は入れず、雑誌の会社にも新住所を知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部屋番号を確認して提出し友人を対象に入れず雑誌会社にも住所を知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the form home today, check the new room number, then submit it. I will leave my friend's name off and notify the magazine company too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the room number before submitting, exclude your friend, and notify the magazine company. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 用紙はこちらです。記入中に迷った点があれば窓口でご確認ください。新生活が順調に始まりますように。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the form. If anything is unclear while filling it in, check with the counter. I hope your new life starts well. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 登録住所の変更をご希望ですね。現在のご登録から、どの点が変わりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to change your registered address. What has changed from your current registration?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社の寮を出て、自分で借りた部屋に住んでいます。銀行の郵便が寮や会社に届かないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 寮から新居に移り銀行の郵便が寮や会社に届かないようにしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left the company dormitory and now live in a room I rented myself. I do not want bank mail going to the dormitory or my company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you moved from the dormitory and do not want bank mail delivered to the dormitory or company. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず現在の登録を確認します。この口座には寮の住所が登録されていますが、勤務先を送付先にする登録はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: First I will check the current registration. This account has the dormitory address, but there is no registration for mail to your workplace.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 勤務先には送られないんですね。新居の住所には、建物名と部屋番号も入れてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 勤務先送付がないと理解し新住所に建物名と部屋番号も入れてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it will not go to my workplace. Could you include the building name and room number in the new address too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that you understand there is no workplace delivery and request the building name and room number in the new address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、正確にご記入ください。新しい住所を確認できる本人確認書類はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, please write it accurately. Have you brought identification showing the new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 在留カードの裏面に新住所が記載されています。通帳と一緒に持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 在留カード裏面の新住所記載と持参した通帳を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The new address is on the back of my residence card. I brought it along with my passbook.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Mention the new address on the back of your residence card and the passbook you brought. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できました。この用紙の住所欄をご記入ください。すでに発送した郵便は変更に間に合わない場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I have confirmed it. Please fill in the address field on this form. Mail already sent may not be affected in time by the change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 住所を記入しました。すでに寮へ送られた物があるかも確認したいです。寮の担当者に聞く前に、ここで発送の有無を調べてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新住所を記入したと伝え寮担当者に連絡する前に銀行で発送済みの通知があるか調べてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have entered the address. I would also like to check whether anything was already sent to the dormitory. Before asking its staff, could you check here whether anything was sent?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you entered the new address and ask the bank to check notices already sent before contacting dormitory staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらで確認できる発送記録を調べます。今日確認した範囲では発送中の通知はありません。住所変更の登録も完了しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check the dispatch records available here. Within what we checked today, there are no notices in transit. Your address update is also complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: よかったです。記入した建物名と部屋番号に間違いがないか、最後に控えで確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 控えで建物名と部屋番号の誤りがないか最後に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: That is a relief. Lastly, I want to check the copy to make sure the building name and room number I wrote are correct.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you want a final check of the building name and room number on the copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この控えでご確認ください。訂正がなければお持ち帰りいただけます。本日はお手続きありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check this copy. If no correction is needed, you may take it home. Thank you for completing the procedure today. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そのポテトサラダの表示をお探しですか。原材料欄は容器の横にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the label on that potato salad? The ingredients are on the side of the container.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 食事の好みで乳製品を控えています。アレルギーではありませんが、この『脱脂粉乳』は乳の原料ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: アレルギーではなく好みで乳製品を控え脱脂粉乳が乳原料か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I avoid dairy as a dietary preference. It is not an allergy, but is this 'skimmed milk powder' a milk ingredient?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that avoiding dairy is a preference, not an allergy, and ask whether skimmed milk powder is a milk ingredient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、牛乳から作られる原料です。この商品の表示には乳成分が含まれると書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, it is made from cow's milk. This product's label says it contains milk ingredients.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、このサラダはやめます。代わりに、味付けをしていないゆでたじゃがいもはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: サラダを選ばず味付けしていないゆでたじゃがいもがあるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I will not take this salad. Do you have plain boiled potatoes without seasoning instead?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decline the salad and ask for unseasoned boiled potatoes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらのパックがあります。表示上の原材料はじゃがいもだけです。内容をご覧になって選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We have this pack. The only ingredient listed is potato. Please read the contents and choose.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このパックにします。一人では一度に食べきれないので、開けた後は常温に置いておけるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: じゃがいもパックを選ぶが一度で食べきれず開封後の常温保存が可能か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will take this pack. I cannot finish it all at once alone, so I want to check whether it can stay at room temperature after opening.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the potato pack but ask about room-temperature storage after opening because you cannot finish it at once. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示では要冷蔵です。開封後も冷蔵し、早めにお召し上がりください。未開封の期限が、開けた後もそのまま使えるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The label says keep refrigerated. Refrigerate it after opening too, and eat it soon. The unopened date does not necessarily remain valid once opened.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 開けた後はこの期限まで保存できると考えないほうがよいんですね。半分だけの小さいパックもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未開封の期限が開封後も保証しないと理解し小さいパックを探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I should not assume I can keep it until this date after opening. Is there a smaller pack with only half as much?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show understanding that the unopened date is no guarantee after opening and look for a smaller pack. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この棚の下段に少量パックがあります。原材料と保存表示は大きい物と同じですが、内容量が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: There are small packs on this shelf's bottom level. The ingredients and storage labels are the same as the large pack, but the quantity differs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: それなら少量パックを選びます。持ち帰ったら冷蔵して、開けた日は期限だけを頼りにせず早めに食べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 少量を買い帰宅後冷蔵し開封したら期限だけに頼らず早めに食べると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will choose the small pack. I will refrigerate it when I get home, and after opening eat it promptly rather than relying only on the date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will buy a small amount, refrigerate it at home, and eat it soon after opening without relying only on the date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認ありがとうございます。お会計は右のレジでどうぞ。またのお越しをお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. Please pay at the till on the right. We look forward to your next visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そちらの道は、今日は行事の準備で通れません。散歩の経路をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: That path is closed today for event preparations. Are you looking for a walking route?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、久しぶりに歩くので、十分くらいの短い散歩にしたいです。この先が閉まっているなら別の道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 久しぶりなので十分程度にしたく閉鎖中の道以外を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, it has been a while since I walked, so I want a short walk of about ten minutes. If that way is closed, is there another path?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want about ten minutes because it has been a while, and ask for a route other than the closed one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この案内板の黄色い線が、今日通れる道です。噴水まで行って戻ると、ゆっくり歩いて十分ほどです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The yellow line on this board marks today's open path. Going to the fountain and back takes about ten minutes at a gentle pace.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 以前の地図では噴水から先へ抜けられますが、今日はそこで引き返すんですね。帰りもこの入口に戻れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今日は噴水で引き返すと確認し同じ入口へ戻れるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The old map shows a through route beyond the fountain, but today we turn back there, right? Can I return to this same entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that today you turn back at the fountain and ask whether you can return to the same entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、今日は一周せず、来た道を戻ってください。分かれ道では黄色い案内を目印にすると、この入口へ戻れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, do not make a circuit today; return by the way you came. At forks, follow the yellow signs to get back to this entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 途中で水を飲みたいです。噴水の近くに飲める水が出る場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 噴水の近くに飲み水を補給できる設備があるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to drink water along the way. Is there a drinking-water facility near the fountain?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether drinking-water refill facilities are available near the fountain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 飲み水の設備は修理中です。噴水の水は飲めません。お水をお持ちでなければ、出発前にご用意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The drinking-water facility is under repair. The fountain water is not drinkable. If you do not have water, prepare some before leaving.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 水は持っています。噴水のそばで立って飲むと通行の邪魔になりませんか。休める場所も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 水は持参しており通行を妨げず休める場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have water. Would I block others if I stood and drank by the fountain? I would also like to know somewhere to rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you brought water and ask somewhere to rest without obstructing others. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 道から少し離れた休憩スペースにベンチがあります。そこで休んでから、黄色い案内に沿って戻ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: There are benches in a rest area a little off the path. Rest there, then return following the yellow signs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 水を持って黄色い線の道を歩き、噴水の休憩スペースで少し休みます。今日は先へ抜けず、同じ入口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 水を持参し黄色い案内の道で休憩スペースへ行き先へ抜けず同じ入口へ戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will bring water, follow the yellow-line path, and rest a little in the fountain rest area. Today I will not go through farther; I will return to the same entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will bring water, follow yellow signs to the rest area, and return to the same entrance without continuing through. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それで大丈夫です。柵の内側には入らず、無理のないペースでお歩きください。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41206-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: That is fine. Do not go inside the barriers, and walk at a comfortable pace. Enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その荷物、運びにくそうですね。どちらのホームへ行かれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: That luggage looks awkward to carry. Which platform are you going to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二番ホームに行きたいんですが、ケースの持ち手が引き出せなくなりました。階段を使わずに行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ケースの持ち手の故障と二番ホームへの階段なしの経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Platform two, but my case handle will no longer extend. Can I get there without using stairs?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the faulty case handle and ask for a stair-free route to platform two. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 改札を入って右にエレベーターがあります。上の通路を渡って、向こう側のエレベーターで降りられますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is an elevator to the right after the gates. Cross the upper passage and take the elevator on the other side down.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ケースを横にして持っています。改札では、荷物を持ち上げずに通れる幅の広い通路がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ケースを横向きで持っていると伝え、広い改札通路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am carrying the case sideways. Is there a wide gate passage where I can pass without lifting the luggage?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you are carrying the case sideways and ask for a wide gate passage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの有人通路をお通りください。切符は私が確認します。車輪が転がるなら、床に置いていただいて大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please use this staffed passage. I will check the ticket. If the wheels roll, it is fine to put it on the floor.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 車輪は動きます。途中で止まって持ち直しても、後ろの人の邪魔にならない場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 車輪が動くと伝え、荷物を持ち直せる場所を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: The wheels work. Is there somewhere I can stop and adjust my grip without blocking people behind me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the wheels work and check somewhere to readjust the luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: エレベーターを降りた先に待合スペースがあります。出入口をふさがないよう、そちらで持ち直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is a waiting area beyond the elevator exit. Adjust it there without blocking the doorway.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 次の列車まで五分しかありません。急いで運ぶのは不安なので、一本後にしてもいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 五分では不安なため一本後の列車を使えるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: There are only five minutes until the next train. I am worried about rushing with this, so could I take the one after?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can take the following train because five minutes feels too rushed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お持ちの切符は列車指定ではないので、後の列車にも使えます。発車時刻はこの表示でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Your ticket is not for a specified train, so it can be used on a later one. Please check the departure time on this display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では一本後にします。有人通路から入ってエレベーターを使い、待合スペースで荷物を整えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 後の列車を選び、有人通路とエレベーターと待合スペースを使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will take the one after. I will enter through the staffed passage, use the elevators, and organize my luggage in the waiting area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will choose a later train and use the staffed passage, elevators, and waiting area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 切符を確認しました。こちらからどうぞ。無理に急がず、足元にもお気をつけください。それでは、いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have checked your ticket. This way, please. Do not rush beyond your ability, and watch your step. Have a good journey.
